The supplied beta_test.go is currently an empty file, which is not valid Go: the package fails to compile with "expected 'package', found 'EOF'". The spec covers this implicitly by requiring the RED stage to write the full file with `package sample`, but it never says so. "Contains exactly one test function" doesn't say whether non-Test helper functions are allowed. The contract "No new functions" suggests they aren't, but the wording could be tighter. This doesn't affect whether the spec can be met, because a single TestBeta with an inline check satisfies both.
